description.short: Visual feedback pins from your web apps, routed to Teams - notifications, replies, and a Home tab.
description.full:
Pincushion is a visual feedback annotation system. Stakeholders drop pins on any web page via a Chrome extension; developers (and their AI agents) read those pins and implement the fixes. With the Microsoft Teams app:

- Notifications land in any channel when pins are ready, @-mentioned, or followed up
- Direct messages when you are @-mentioned in a pin thread
- Reply to a pin directly from the Teams thread - replies sync back as pin comments
- A Home tab showing connected projects, open pins, and your @-mentions

Defaults are intentionally low-noise: only mentions, ready pins, and follow-ups by default. Per-channel event subscriptions. Inline pin screenshots so reviewers see what was annotated without clicking through.
